This summary frames the background of the observations, analysis, and insights from the 10 deployments that were cataloged and tracked through Phase I and Phase II. 3.1 Ten Early Deployment Sites Phase I of the AMD research effort documented the then 10 leading AV transport early deployment sites, with updates for each site provided in Phase II. Tracking and analysis of these sites began in 2019 and has continued through to this third edition, with updates and insights reported accordingly. As of the end of 2024, five of these sites are no longer operational, whereas the remaining five continue toward implementation. Updates on sites with significant progress and/or lessons learned are provided next. Readers are directed to the first and second edition of the catalog for greater detail. The initial 10 early deployment sites that have been tracked since the 2019/2020 time frame and their status (as of 2025) are listed in Table 1.
